== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[sacred artists|Sacred artists]] are practitioners of the [[sacred arts]], a discipline that utilizes [[madra]] to reinforce their physical constitution and manipulate energy. This practice involves following specific [[Paths]], such as the [[Path of the White Fox]], which can lead to various stages of [[advancement]]. Notable ranks include [[Iron]], [[Copper]], [[Gold]] (with sub-stages like [[Highgold]]), and the realm of [[Underlord]] or [[Underlady]]. The ultimate stage for any artist is [[Gold]], representing a [[spirit]] as pure as gold. To advance, [[sacred artists]] must possess intense drive and the resolve to overcome significant obstacles, often sacrificing comfort, pride, and safety for power. Many train their bodies before progressing through different stages. Highly advanced artists often display a sense of confidence or arrogance and are known to value their reputation immensely. In many societies, there is a strict hierarchy where those of lower [[advancement]] levels instinctively defer to the stronger. [[sacred artists|Sacred artists]] utilize various techniques, sometimes incorporating natural spirits or specialized weapons into their practice. While some rely on [[constructs]], many use permanent sacred instruments to better conduct [[willpower]] and add power to their [[binding|bindings]]. Upon death, a powerful sacred artist may leave behind a [[Remnant]]—a living force of [[pure madra]] that serves as a part of their [[spirit]]. These [[Remnants]] can be bonded by other artists, allowing them to inherit insights and techniques from their predecessors.}}

== Soulsmith ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|[[sacred artists|Sacred artists]] are members of specific clans who utilize [[madra]] to perform their arts. These practitioners are capable of reaching the realm of [[Underlord]], and some have even mastered techniques to manifest [[water]] from the [[aura]] present in the air. Ultimately, a sacred artist is measured by their response to risk, with drive serving as their most essential quality.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">5</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|[[sacred artists|Sacred artists]] are members of clans who use [[madra]].<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c4">''Soulsmith'', chapter 4</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|A [[sacred artist]] once mastered a [[technique]] to make [[water]] from the [[aura]] in the air.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c11">''Soulsmith'', chapter 11</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|[[sacred artists|Sacred artists]] can reach the realm of [[Underlord]].<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c11" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|The measure of a [[sacred artist]] is how they respond to risk.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c14">''Soulsmith'', chapter 14</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|[[Drive]] is the most important quality for any [[sacred artist]].<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c15">''Soulsmith'', chapter 15</ref>}}</li>
</ul></div>
